scope: src/app/include/tests/tools/python; manual read of declarations, control reads and constructor bodies; not a formal whole-program proof

findings.name: NraSolver::enableSubtropical_
findings.effect: constant true private field, sole early-return read and no setter or assignment; retain validated candidate search and combination applicability checks

findings.name: NraSolver::enableSignRefute_
findings.effect: constant true private field, sole early-return read and no setter or assignment; retain sign-definiteness algorithm, explanations and combination applicability checks

findings.name: CadicalTheoryPropagator::decideSteer_
findings.effect: declaration-only private false field with obsolete XOLVER_LRA_DECIDE comment; no read or write in src/app/include/tests/tools/python. XOLVER_LRA_DECIDE itself is live and read locally in CadicalTheoryPropagator.cpp; this finding covers only the redundant member, not the decision heuristic or its named control.

findings.name: NraSolver::enableCac_
findings.effect: constant true private field, one early-return guard and one diagnostic-stream read; no setter or assignment in src/app/include/tests/tools/python; retain CAC algorithm and applicability checks

findings.name: CacEngine::Config::inloopPrune
findings.effect: Config defaults false; NraSolver always enables it via a constant-true local and four tests opt in. A live guard controls interval-subsumption pruning. The old named control survives only in comments, so the named-control inventory does not count this independent internal gate. Retain the used algorithm when removing the switch; do not classify it as an unused default-off experiment.
